info.title: SofaScore Scraper API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API of the SofaScore scraper. Single resources are returned as {"data": {...}}, collections as {"data": [...], "page": {"limit", "next_cursor"}}, errors as {"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}. Messages are English; clients translate by code. When an access token is configured, every request needs Authorization: Bearer <token> or the session cookie.

get.description: The server is up; whether SofaScore answers it; the request budget.

Service state: versions, access to SofaScore, the request budget, the job that is running now, the live
service, what the data directory holds (with its path and the last migration), the leases held right now,
the sinks at a glance and the optional features. When the data directory cannot be read, `live`, `summary`
and `sinks` are null and `storage_error` has the error code.

post.description:
Send one request to SofaScore now (the live list of football) and report whether it was answered. Only
called when the user asks; it takes a turn of the shared request budget. A failed check answers 200 with
`ok: false` and the `reason`: blocked, browser, rate_limited, network or upstream.

get.description: The registered sports, in registry order, each with the detail slices that apply to it.

The sinks of the configuration (config file `[[sink]]` or SOFASCORE_SINKS), in their order, with the
position each has delivered up to and how far it lags behind the event log. Sinks are configured in the
file only; this route only reads. Credentials in webhook addresses are masked. Whether a process
delivers right now is `served` (the holder of the `sinks` lease is in `/status` `leases`).
Whether an access token is required and whether this caller presents it. Answers without a token.

post.summary: Sign in with the access token
post.description:
Exchange the access token for a session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict). Without a configured token the
call does nothing and reports `authenticated`. A wrong token is 401 `unauthorized` with
`details.reason = "invalid_token"`; after repeated wrong tokens from one address the attempts are refused
for a while (401 with `details.reason = "too_many_attempts"` and `Retry-After`), the right token included.
Delete the session cookie of this browser.

post.summary: Search tournaments, teams and players on SofaScore
post.description:
Look the text up on SofaScore (one request, the shared request budget), at most 20 hits of the kinds asked
for (`kinds`; tournaments by default), each typed by `kind`. An empty list: SofaScore answered and found
nothing. 503 `blocked` / `rate_limited` and 502 `upstream_error` when it did not answer; `details.reason` is
blocked, browser, rate_limited, network or upstream. POST, because every call sends a request to SofaScore (a
GET could be triggered by another site).

Made for typing: the server keeps each answer for 10 minutes, so the same text again (case and spaces
ignored) sends nothing to SofaScore. When the client closes the connection before the request was sent
(for example while it waits for its turn in the request budget), it is not sent at all.

post.description:
Start a job in the background and return it at once (202). Only one job writes to a data directory at a
time: while another job or a data operation runs, in this server or in another process, the request is
refused with 409 and the holder in `details`. `clear`, `rebuild` and a real `restore` take the data
directory for themselves (no download, live service or other data operation may run). A `clear` needs
`confirm: true` (400 `confirmation_required`). `restore` checks by default (`dry_run: true`); with
`dry_run: false` it restores, and into a data directory that is not empty only with `force: true` (else 400
`confirmation_required` with `details.occupied`). A Parquet export without pyarrow on the server is 501.
A `sync` with `only: "seasons"` reads season lists only; `follows` names the follows to sync; a `fetch` with
`event_ids` fetches events without their tournament, and a `refresh` with `event_ids` reads those events again.

class.title: Class
class.description: The platform's class of the status. `not_started`: not begun. `live`: in progress, breaks included (half time, the night between two days of a cricket match: type `willcontinue`). `completed`: played and finished. `decided_without_play`: finished by walkover or retirement. `void`: postponed, cancelled, interrupted, suspended or abandoned. `unknown`: none of these; never silently treated as completed.

EventStatus.description: The status of an event: SofaScore's triple and the platform's class.

team_ids.description: Only events of these teams (the id of `participant` in `GET /events`, of a team follow; in tennis, darts, MMA … a player or a pair). With `player_ids` one filter: an event of any of the teams or players.

ExportJobSpec.title: ExportJobSpec
ExportJobSpec.description:
What to export. Schema `normalized`: the records of data schema v1 (`events`, `slices`, `changes`, `odds`: one
row per outcome of each odds snapshot, `standings`: the standings rows of the matched events' seasons) as JSONL
(one record per line), CSV, Parquet or SQLite (one column per leaf field, named by its path joined with `_`;
lists as JSON text). Parquet needs the optional package pyarrow on the server (501 `not_supported` without
it). Schema `raw`: the stored payloads as JSONL (dataset `events`: the event payload only, `slices`: every
slice). The profile `legacy-wide-csv` is 2.x's wide CSV (dataset `events`, format `csv`).

spec.description: What the job was started with. progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Phase, counters and failed items; the last progress event for a job of another process. The progress events carry the same object.

last_job_id.description: The last job the task started.

last_result.description: `skipped_running`: its previous run still ran; `skipped_busy`: another job or data operation held the data directory.

ScheduledRun.title: ScheduledRun
ScheduledRun.description: One task of the in-app scheduler (config file `[[schedule.task]]`) and its next run.

tournament_id.title: Tournament Id
tournament_id.description: Id of the Tournament the season belongs to.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the season, for example `Premier League 26/27`.

year.title: Year
year.description: The season's year text as SofaScore writes it: `26/27`, `2025`.

events.title: Events
events.description: Every stored event of the season, unfinished schedule rows included.

finished.title: Finished
finished.description: Events that ended (completed or decided without play).

details.title: Details
details.description: Events with a stored event payload.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: Finished events with details and no missing slice.

completion_rate.title: Completion Rate
completion_rate.description: complete / finished_details in percent, two decimals; 0 without finished events with details. An event not played yet cannot miss its statistics or line-ups: it is not counted (FX-26).

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: Slice to the number of finished events with details that miss it.

schedule_fetched_at_utc.title: Schedule Fetched At Utc
schedule_fetched_at_utc.description: When the newest page of the season's schedule was fetched; null: never.

finished_details.title: Finished Details
finished_details.description: Finished events with a stored event payload.

SeasonCounts.title: SeasonCounts
SeasonCounts.description: Counts of one season of a tournament, from the catalog (`include=counts`).

tournament_id.title: Tournament Id
tournament_id.description: Id of the Tournament the season belongs to.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the season, for example `Premier League 26/27`.

year.title: Year
year.description: The season's year text as SofaScore writes it: `26/27`, `2025`.

SeasonEntry.title: SeasonEntry
SeasonEntry.description: A season (schema v1 Season); with `include=counts` also its counts.

number.title: Number
number.description: Number of the set, starting at 1.

home.title: Home
home.description: What the home side won in the set, as `SetsScore.format` says: games in tennis and padel (points when the set is a match tie-break), points in volleyball, badminton and table tennis, legs in darts played in sets. In e-sports (`games_won`) the set is a game (map) and this is its score as SofaScore gives it: rounds in titles played in rounds (CS2), else 1 for the side that won the game and 0 for the other.

away.title: Away
away.description: What the away side won in the set, as `SetsScore.format` says: games in tennis and padel (points when the set is a match tie-break), points in volleyball, badminton and table tennis, legs in darts played in sets. In e-sports (`games_won`) the set is a game (map) and this is its score as SofaScore gives it: rounds in titles played in rounds (CS2), else 1 for the side that won the game and 0 for the other.

tiebreak.description: Points of the set's tie-break. Null when the set had none, and always null outside tennis and padel.

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side: sets won; the frames, legs or games won with the formats `frames`, `legs_won` and `games_won`.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side: sets won; the frames, legs or games won with the formats `frames`, `legs_won` and `games_won`.

format.title: Format
format.description: What the score counts. `games`, `points`, `legs`: sets won, and each set counts games (tennis, padel), points (volleyball, badminton, table tennis) or legs (darts played in sets). `frames`, `legs_won`: no sets; `sets_won` and the headline score are the frames (snooker) or legs (darts played in legs only or in a single set) won. `games_won`: `sets_won` and the headline score are the games (maps) won in e-sports, and each set is a game. Null when the record has no score sheet.

sets_won.description: Sets won by each side; the frames, legs or games won with the formats `frames`, `legs_won` and `games_won`.

sets.title: Sets
sets.description: The sets that have a score, in order. Empty with the formats `frames` and `legs_won`. With `games_won` the games (maps) that have a score; a game SofaScore gives as 0-0 (not played, or the one being played while live) is left out.

match_tiebreak.title: Match Tiebreak
match_tiebreak.description: True when the deciding set was a match tie-break (first to 10 points) and not a normal set. A heuristic: the last of three or five sets has a side with 10 or more. Always false outside tennis and padel.

SetsScore.title: SetsScore
SetsScore.description: Score family `sets`: sets won and the score of each set. Tennis and padel count games per set; volleyball, badminton and table tennis count points; darts played in sets counts legs per set; snooker and darts played in legs only give only the frames or legs won and no sets; e-sports give the games (maps) won and the score of each game.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value in force. Secrets are masked.

source.title: Source
source.description: The layer the value comes from, weakest to strongest in this order.

source_name.title: Source Name
source_name.description: The file or the environment variable, when there is one.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Pinned by the config file, the environment or a flag: a change made here would have no effect.

writable.title: Writable
writable.description: Whether PATCH accepts this key right now.

type.title: Type
type.description: `rate`: requests per second, 0 or "off" for no limit; `seasons`: current, all, last:N or a list of season ids; `string_list`: a list of strings.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the setting does, in English.

minimum.title: Minimum
minimum.description: Lowest accepted value, when there is one.

exclusive_minimum.title: Exclusive Minimum
exclusive_minimum.description: The value must be above `minimum`, not equal to it.

maximum.title: Maximum
maximum.description: Highest accepted value, when there is one.

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Longest accepted text when changed through the API.

restart_needed.title: Restart Needed
restart_needed.description: A change takes effect only after `ssc serve` or `ssc watch` is started again.

SettingMetadata.title: SettingMetadata
SettingMetadata.description: How a setting can be changed (05-web-ui.md G4). One row per setting, in the order of `settings`.

config_file.title: Config File
config_file.description: Path of the config file in use, if any.

overrides_file.title: Overrides File
overrides_file.description: Path of the file PATCH has written, if any.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Type, limits, choices, section and restart need of each setting, in the order of `settings`.

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Per-sport changes to the default slice selection ([slices.<sport>]), one row per registered sport in registry order. Change one with PATCH `{"values": {"slices.<sport>": {"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}}}`; null removes it.

values.title: Values
values.description: `section.key` to the new value; null removes the value written here earlier. `slices.<sport>` takes `{"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}`.

target.title: Target
target.description: The file path, or the webhook address with its credentials masked.

events.title: Events
events.description: Event type patterns the sink takes.

state.title: State
state.description: `pending`: the sink has delivered nothing yet; `error`: the last delivery failed.

served.title: Served
served.description: A process holds the `sinks` lease and delivers right now.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Sequence number of the last event delivered to the sink.

head_seq.title: Head Seq
head_seq.description: Sequence number of the newest event of the log.

lag_events.title: Lag Events
lag_events.description: Events of the log after the cursor (all types, before the sink's filter).

lag_seconds.title: Lag Seconds
lag_seconds.description: Age of the oldest undelivered event; null when none.

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: Undelivered events given up as too old, as far as the retained log tells.

SinkStatus.title: SinkStatus
SinkStatus.description: A configured output sink and how far it has delivered the event log.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Sinks that have delivered nothing yet.

served.title: Served
served.description: A process holds the `sinks` lease and delivers right now.

max_lag_events.title: Max Lag Events
max_lag_events.description: The largest `lag_events` of a sink; 0 without sinks.

max_lag_seconds.title: Max Lag Seconds
max_lag_seconds.description: Age of the oldest event a sink has not received; null when every sink is current.

SinksSummary.title: SinksSummary
SinksSummary.description: The configured sinks at a glance (`/sinks` has each one).

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: Id of the owner; for `event` the event id.

key.title: Key
key.description: Name of the slice, for example `event`, `statistics`, `lineups`, `incidents`.

sub.title: Sub
sub.description: Sub-key for a slice that has several payloads per owner, for example the round of a schedule page. Null when the slice has one payload.

state.title: State
state.description: `ok`: a payload with data is stored. `empty`: SofaScore answered that it has no such data (404, or a response without content). `error`: the last attempt failed and it is unknown whether data exists. `not_requested`: the platform has not asked for it.

has_payload.title: Has Payload
has_payload.description: True when a payload is stored. A slice in state `error` can still hold the payload of an earlier successful read.

fetched_at_utc.title: Fetched At Utc
fetched_at_utc.description: When the stored payload was read.

checked_at_utc.title: Checked At Utc
checked_at_utc.description: When the slice was last asked for, whatever the outcome.

error.description: The last failure. Null unless the state is `error`.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The stored SofaScore response, unchanged (see Raw on request). Present only when asked for; null otherwise.

Slice.title: Slice
Slice.description: One stored response of SofaScore about an event or another entity, and its state.

http_status.title: Http Status
http_status.description: HTTP status of the failed response, when there was one.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many attempts in a row have failed.

SliceError.title: SliceError
SliceError.description: The last failed attempt to fetch a slice.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: Slices selected for the event's sport and phase.

empty.title: Empty
empty.description: Selected slices SofaScore answered without data.

error.title: Error
error.description: Selected slices whose last request failed.

SliceSummary.title: SliceSummary
SliceSummary.description: How much of an event's selected data is stored.

i18n_key.title: I18N Key
i18n_key.description: Translation key of the name for clients.

individual.title: Individual
individual.description: One against one (or a pair against a pair): SofaScore lists the players of this sport as teams (`homeTeam`, search hits of kind `team`), so such a team is a player for the reader.

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Every slice that applies to the sport, disabled ones included.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path of the slice in SofaScore's API, with `{event_id}`.

required.title: Required
required.description: Counts for completeness in this sport: a match missing it is fetched again. False: requested when selected, but SofaScore does not always have it for this sport.

default_enabled.title: Default Enabled
default_enabled.description: Selected when no selection names it (the registry's default).

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: Selected by the configured defaults for this sport (`defaults.slices` and `slices.<sport>` of GET /settings); a follow can choose otherwise.

group.title: Group
group.description: Slice group; a selection can name the group instead of the key.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: What the payload belongs to; one request per owner.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: Match phases in which the slice can exist (before, during, after the match).

keep_history.title: Keep History
keep_history.description: Changed payloads are kept as a history (odds).

max_age_seconds.title: Max Age Seconds
max_age_seconds.description: Owner slices: fetched again when older than this; null = once.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: Slice keys or groups added to `defaults.slices` for this sport.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Slice keys or groups removed for this sport (applied after `enable`).

source.title: Source
source.description: The layer the sport's selection comes from; `default` when none is set.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Pinned by the config file or the environment ([slices.<sport>]).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the stage, for example `UEFA Champions League, Group A` or `Wimbledon, London, GB, Qualifying, 1st - 2nd Round`.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: The part of a tournament an event belongs to: SofaScore's (non-unique) tournament object.

table.title: Table
table.description: Which table: `total` (all matches) or `home` (home matches only).

group_name.title: Group Name
group_name.description: Name of the table or group, for example `Premier League 26/27` or `Group A`.

position.title: Position
position.description: Rank in the table, 1 for the first.

draws.title: Draws
draws.description: Matches drawn; null in sports without draws.

points.title: Points
points.description: Table points (a fraction in a few sports).

StandingsRow.title: StandingsRow
StandingsRow.description: One row of a standings table of a season.

StartBackupJob.title: StartBackupJob
StartBackupJob.description: Write a backup zip into the data directory's `backups/`; download it through `/backups/{name}`.

StartClearJob.title: StartClearJob
StartClearJob.description:
Delete stored data (follows, job history, change log, backups and exports stay): by scope, or one
tournament's (or one season's) data with `tournament_id` (and `season_id`).

StartExportJob.title: StartExportJob
StartExportJob.description: Write an export file into the data directory's `exports/`; download it through `/exports/{id}/download`.

StartFetchJob.title: StartFetchJob
StartFetchJob.description: Event details only, for the schedules that are already stored.

StartRebuildJob.title: StartRebuildJob
StartRebuildJob.description: Rebuild the catalog (`.meta/catalog.db`) from the stored files.

StartRefreshJob.title: StartRefreshJob
StartRefreshJob.description: Re-read the stored events that may still change.

StartRestoreJob.title: StartRestoreJob
StartRestoreJob.description:
Check what restoring a backup would do (`dry_run: true`, the Check step of the UI), or restore it
(`dry_run: false`, the Choose step). A restore replaces the data and the job history; this job stays in it.

StartSyncJob.title: StartSyncJob
StartSyncJob.description: Season lists, schedules and event details.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Version of the normalized schema of the records this API returns (`sofascore.data/<n>`).

auth_required.title: Auth Required
auth_required.description: Whether an access token is configured.

active_job.description: The job that runs on the data directory right now, in any process.

live.description: The live service; null when the store cannot be read.

summary.description: Null when the store cannot be read.

leases.title: Leases
leases.description: Leases held right now, in any process.

sinks.description: Null when the store cannot be read.

schedule.description: The in-app scheduler and the next runs of its tasks.

storage_error.title: Storage Error
storage_error.description: Error code when the data directory could not be read; the fields that need it are empty.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the check failed; null when it succeeded.

events_count.title: Events Count
events_count.description: Live events in the answer; null on failure.

StatusCheck.title: StatusCheck
StatusCheck.description: The outcome of one connection check; a failed check is a result, not an error.

target.title: Target
target.description: `sofascore`: one request for the live list of football.

league_id.title: League Id
league_id.description: One tournament, every season of it.

follows.title: Follows
follows.description: `sync` only: these follows (`tournament:17`, `team:42`, `player:7`, `event:123`). A tournament with its season choice; a team or a player with its matches (the previous and next pages of SofaScore's list within the follow's window: `seasons` `current` = the last 365 days, `last:N` = N × 365 days, `all` = up to five pages back, season ids = those seasons); an event follow that one match. Season lists only (`only: "seasons"`) read tournaments only.

only.title: Only
only.description: `sync` only. `seasons`: read the season lists from SofaScore again now, without schedules or event details (the Get season list button).

event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: `fetch` only: these events, whether or not their tournament is known or followed. Not with `league_id` or `selections`.

SyncJobSpec.title: SyncJobSpec
SyncJobSpec.description:
What to download. Without `selections`, `league_id` and `follows`: every enabled follow, each tournament with
its own season choice, each team, player and event follow with its matches. Only one of `league_id`,
`selections` and `follows` may be given.

id.title: Id
id.description: SofaScore's id of the competitor (the id space of `homeTeam` / `awayTeam`: teams, single players and pairs share it; it is not the person id of a squad player).

type.title: Type
type.description: What the competitor is: `team`, `player` (one person, as in tennis singles), `pair` (two persons, as in tennis doubles) or `other` (a type code the platform does not know). Null when SofaScore gave no type.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: SofaScore's two-letter country code, as given.

followed.title: Followed
followed.description: A team follow of any origin names this competitor.

TeamRecord.title: TeamRecord
TeamRecord.description:
A competitor as the catalog knows it from its stored events (schema v1 Participant): a team, or in a sport of one
against one a player or a pair (SofaScore lists them as teams). `gender`, `national` and `country_code` tell
same-named teams apart (a men's and a women's team, a club and a national team).

ThrottleStatus.title: ThrottleStatus
ThrottleStatus.description: The request budget shared by all processes of this machine.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Slug of a registered sport; null for others.

category.description: The tournament's category; for a team or a player only `country_code` can be set.

country.description: Country of the tournament's category, of the team or of the player.

team.description: A player's team; null for the other kinds and for a player without a club (SofaScore's placeholder team `No team` is left out).

followed.title: Followed
followed.description: A follow of any origin names this tournament, team or player already.

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: Gender of a team as SofaScore gives it: `M` (men) or `F` (women); null when it is not known (tournaments, players, a stored team whose events did not say). Tells same-named men's and women's teams apart.

national.title: National
national.description: The team is a national team; null when it is not known.

TournamentHit.title: TournamentHit
TournamentHit.description:
A tournament, a team or a player SofaScore found (`kind`). Follow it with `POST /follows` (`kind`,
`entity_id` = `id`, `name`, `sport`).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the tournament, in English.

category.description: The tournament's Category; null when the catalog does not know it.

followed.title: Followed
followed.description: A follow of any origin names the tournament.

TournamentRecord.title: TournamentRecord
TournamentRecord.description: A tournament (schema v1 Tournament) with its category and whether it is followed.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: What to look for: tournaments (the default), teams and players. Tournaments alone ask SofaScore's tournament search; any other choice asks its general search (one request either way).

TournamentSearch.title: TournamentSearch
TournamentSearch.description: What to look for on SofaScore.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the follow, else the stored tournament name.

followed.title: Followed
followed.description: A follow of any origin names the tournament (the follows table).

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Events counted as matches (the `only_finished` rule of the summary).

details.title: Details
details.description: Events with a stored event payload.

events.title: Events
events.description: Every stored event, unfinished schedule rows included.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.description: Seasons in the tournament's stored season list.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: details / matches in percent, one decimal; 0 without matches.

last_update_utc.title: Last Update Utc
last_update_utc.description: Newest change of a stored payload.

finished_details.title: Finished Details
finished_details.description: Finished events with a stored event payload. A follow's coverage is finished_details / finished: an event not played yet is not missing (FX-26).

TournamentSummary.title: TournamentSummary
TournamentSummary.description: Counts of one tournament. `tournament_id` null: the events without a unique tournament.
